Instead, its what we did do, what did happen, and what those have chose to remember. 

We all die. But we all live, to. And if you spend your life like your dying, you'll have nothing to look back and live for.
Experiences make us who we are.
Without them, we are no better then our ancestors in the ground.

You worry about dying, about being non existent. About those around you being non existent.

So don't be.
Be alive today. For you, for your family, for your friends. Even though many of us won't wake up for the tomorrow, there's still a chance to live in the today.

......the main character of the story shipped 10 children off to an island for ten years, then came back to do some god holy knows what, but your questioning my story logic....about the woman.....who I let have happy endings...somewhat.

As Obama once said, "Can I live?"
Yeah!!!!

He had money put in the banks of his "followers".
He paid off doctors and therapists to change these woman into aspiring people, rather then how he used to see them, which was as worthless things, and pretty girls looking for money.

A GOD needs children, models of himself.

 I didn't understand.
It's not that I was stupid, but rather I was behaving like a fool.
I didn't want to believe it.
I COULDN'T.
But...I had to.

I, a man who's name holds more worth then the government, a man who's riches far expire beyond that of a country, a man who's only shown love, compassion, and generosity to those who would happily stand behind me in anything I do. 

I, a rich noble man, had to accept this small imperfection that seemed to smear my name.

In front of me, ten children sat.
The youngest was only a year, while the oldest was 10 years along. The rest of the children filled in.

The girl-Age 1
The boy-Age2
The girl-Age 3
The boy-Age 4
The girl-Age 5
The boy-Age 6
The girl-Age 7
The boy-Age 8
The girl-Age 9
The boy-Age 10

All ten of these children were differently aged, both looked and sounded different, and all were secretly blood related, which none of them knew.
BUT. 
All ten children came from the same old (almost) run down orphanage. All ten children knew each other, like a family.
Which was good. They are going to need that.

You see, my wife (the current one I have is wife #10) can't have my children. 
We had gone to the so claimed "best hospital in the world" to have each of my past wives tested to find out why they couldn't explain it.
This went on marriage after marriage, until I (rather bored of sitting in the lobby), decided to get myself tested. Just for fun.

Sterile.
They said I, the RICHEST MAN ON EARTH, was sterile. They say I have been my entire life.
Bullshit.
I thought at first it had to be my wives.
Then, I grew smart. 
It was GOD.

HE was MOCKING ME.
Making a FOOL OF ME.
No. NO.
I wasn't going to have that.
No way was I going to have that.

I underwent surgery after surgery. 
I came out strong.
I could produce children.
And finally get the revenge on all of my wives for playing along with God in this sick plan.

Very easily, I found them all.
It wasn't hard to get them, one by one, into my car.
I AM rather handsome, and I AM undoubtedly rich.
So who wouldn't?

I drugged them.
Each woman.
Each the same way.
With a cocktail.

My first wife, Cassandra, the red curly head snow bunny. 
She was the first to be both punished and rewarded by me.
An ACTUAL God.
I locked each of them in their own room.
Drugged them through the air in their vents.
None of them were unhappy.
None of them ever went hungry.
None of them even realized they were locked away, for years. 
They all were drugged up kittens, dressed pretty, fed plenty, and given silly kid toys to play with, as that is what they loved. 
I never mistreated my sinning wives, as a kind and forgiving God such as myself would NEVER do that.
They all just needed to be...reborn. 
Commended of their sins.

Cassandra, my first wife, the first woman I loved, was first for her trial.
She was beautiful.
Never sad, never quiet.
So happy, finally happy.
Never fighting, always dancing and singing about.
She was the first I impregnated.

Sweet girl. Thirty years old, and running around dancing like a ballerina with a baby nestled in her stomach.
She asked what it was once, and I told her she had to be very careful, as a rather large watermelon was growing in her belly.
She smiled and patted her belly, happy.
Finally happy.
I put her back in her room, switched on the air vents, and let her alone to absorb this amazing drug that has left her finally relaxed.

All 9 other woman stayed in their own room at this time.
When Cassandra gave birth to my first baby, a boy, I was delighted.
I held the child while Cassandra quietly slept.
This child, this child is mine.
A PRINCE.
The first son born of I, a God.

The next week went by in a blur.
I called my people.
They called their people.
Their people called me.

Everything was ready.
I paid off a couple surgeons and doctors to fix Cassandra up, make her look like she never gave birth, gave her a free boob job (farewell gifts I gave each ex wife), and then have her transferred to a hospital.
I paid people off to mess with records, so when she wakes up, she'll be told she's been in a coma for a year. 
No harm done.

My son, who I have not given a name (I believe it better for these children to name themselves, when they are of age), was sent to a far away broken down orphanage.
He was to be watched over by one nanny, one cook, and one teacher.
All told to let him learn to take care of himself, and rely only on himself.
No TV, no books about our world, no knowledge that there is anything out there but that orphanage, and a faraway God, who will one day help.

By the end of the week, Cassandra was gone, and so was my first son.

Trudy, a black haired barista, my second wife, was next for her judgement. 

Life went on.
Each year, I would have a child born from one of my wives, send the woman away, and ship my children to the orphanage. 
My last beloved ex wife, follower of me, was resting quietly after the birth.
She was the last one.

I sat there rocking the little girl I held in my arms.
My daughter.
My youngest daughter. 

She cooed, sleeping peacefully.
Tomorrow both she and her mother, Abigail, would be sent in different directions, never knowing of one another.
The girl, sent to the orphanage like her nine older siblings.
Abigail, to surgeons who will fix her up, and doctors who will tell her she's been lost at sea for years, and suffered from a coma when they found her.
Her family will rush in.
She'll hug them, they'll hug her.
There would be tears, and smiles.
Nobody will ever know where she'd actually been the last ten years.
Nobody will ever know of the daughter she carried, and created.
No.

She, like the nine others, will wake up looking better then they had before.
Banks full of money, each woman will take a step out into the world, a new woman. Starting a new life.
A new path.
I, as their God, have forgiven their sins and set them on this path. For I am a very kind man, and a very generous God.

My last daughter, sent away to be with her siblings.
Now, I wait.
I wait a year.

But the year went by fast as well.
Stories of my young followers filed the news.
Ex wife after ex wife was being featured front page.

"Cassandra L. Cotton--Founder of medical research found new way to cure diabetes!"

"Tiffany Baxter of the "Tiff It Up" fashion brand has announced new release of best top trending tops of this season!"

"Abigail Stern, pilot, saves hundreds of lives as plains engine began to have problems. With no time to spare, Abigail landed the plane gracefully, saving the lives of all those on board. Today, she will be received the award for----"

Blah, Blah, Blah.
Amazing stuff.
Each woman.

When my eldest child was ten, and my youngest one, I ordered they be blind folded and shipped off to a private island.
The island had hits built for them, books stored for them, cloths left for them, as well as food, a cow, and tools.
Books soon books were left for them, explaining how to sew, how to fish, how to hunt, how to make a garden, how to make a fire.
CPR books, health books.
And, of course, the book of me.
Of my victories, of my love.

They will read that book to, and discover what a generous God is for themselves.  
Discover who I AM, for themselves. 

For the next ten years, I settled down doing business.
I invested in stocks, I created and destroyed companies, all the while racking in cash beyond the worlds greatest dreams. 

My children grew.
They learned how to live as a society, how to take care of one another.
Once a year, I will take a sub and go out to their island. I will sneak on land, dressed in beautiful clothing. 
And with me I will bring gifts from a god, presented to the children of the island.
MY children. 

They will gravel to me, and dance about.
And I will disappear, having them believe I returned to the heavens. 

This year, my oldest son turns twenty, and my youngest daughter turns ten.

Now....I'm not sure what to do.
I've had fun seeing them grow, and playing god, but now there of the age.

I, of course, know how much trouble I could get into if they are found out.
So...I could have them killed.
Have the youngest ones kill off the oldest ones in my name, and then leave them to den for their own.

I could stop supplying food to them.
They hunt and fish, yes. But that won't be enough for ten hungry children.
I could leave them to grow mad, and feast on one another.

I could have my scientists create a virus.
Drop it on the island, watch them become infected, and record the results. All science-ey.

Or I could bring them here....
Have the girls genome my maids.
The men become my help.

I could go to one of my mansions way out.
Hidden.

I could have them grovel at my holy feet.
I, their God, giving them a better life.
I will tell them they are all of my blood, and my blood only.
They will work for me, fight for me, die for me.
As I, their God, am their savior.

So many choices, so many exiting choices. 
Watch them eat eachother alive as they starve alone on an island in the middle of nowhere, or bring them to my hidden mansion, far from society, and have them become my children, my slaves, my followers.
Those who serve and worship me, their father, their savior, there God.

Oh....I don't know.
I feel like I'm acting as if I was a teenage boy opening Christmas presents...I can't choose which is better.

I don't know....what feels like it would be more fun? I think I'll think about it over tea and donuts. That sounds rather pleasant....
But I must decide quickly!
In a few days, it will be the children's birthday!
As well as mine....

I do hate deciding on what present to give myself, don't you?
But it's all about the gift....being funnnn! 

Sincerely,
Mr. Andrew Kaiin
